notes: Cash basis (modified cash), governmental funds only; no business-type funds (school nutrition is a governmental fund). Receipts/disbursements are the Total Governmental Funds column on p4; transfers net to zero in that column (GF -200,000, other governmental +200,000, p5) so transfers_in/out are null. Balances from p5 (beginning 5,805,636, ending 6,245,144); CDs (1,666,745) and county treasurer cash are included in the cash totals, so investments left null. The p4 line 'Other nonrevenue receipts' 58,957 is split using the GF schedule on p12 (sale of property 14,851 + insurance adjustments 35,355 + other 8,751). Attempt 3 (audit fixes): p4 'State receipts' 6,039,299 split (split_from) into Homestead Exemption 68,717, Property Tax Credit 1,092,617 and Motor Vehicle Pro-Rate 6,508 using the GF (p11), QCPU (p18) and Special Building (p19) schedule lines, remainder 4,871,457 intergovernmental/state aid (ties to the fund columns incl. nutrition state reimbursement 46,807, p21); 'Instruction support' 158,212 (codes 2210-2240) is support services with detail_category Staff; 'Community service operations' is Community Service Operations (statement and detail); detail 2410 Office of the Principal and 2490 Graduation supplies are School Administration (the statement's General administration line 638,889 includes them and stays General Administration as printed). Detail: General Fund recorded from the budget-and-actual schedule (pp11-15), the more detailed one; the combining schedules (pp7-10) are not duplicated. Separate Depreciation, Employee Benefit, Bond, QCPU, Special Building, Nutrition, Student Fee and Activities fund schedules (pp16-23) recorded per fund. GF lines with blank actuals (1990 Other local receipts, 4530 Other federal categorical receipts, 3500, group budgets) not recorded. Hidden transfer: Student transportation GF 397,587 on p14 includes a 250,000 transfer to the Depreciation Fund (p8 reclassification), recorded as a contra expenditure line and an other-financing line; GF printed total 8,068,925 includes the 200,000 transfers line plus the 250,000 hidden amount. Bond Fund and QCPU Principal lines have only budgets, no actual. The p4 Student support services line (613,646) is split using its column breakdown on p4 and p9: Activities Fund 296,016 as student activities, General Fund 317,047 + Student Fee Fund 583 as support services (matching detail). Balance sheet (user 2026-10-27): governmental lines from the governmental funds statement of assets, liabilities and fund balances (p6), Total Governmental Funds column. Read pages 1-23 of 23
